screenshot_observations: The game bag highlights Repelente with quantity 999.
Superrepelente remains a distinct item with quantity 1.
Money is 999999, confirming the independent money utility succeeded.

identity_evidence.conclusion: Alpha.85 mistranslated MUSIYOKESUPUREE (Repel) as Max Repel. The correct Max Repel identity is item 77.

opendpr.fact: When count is assigned to a record whose SortNumber is zero, ItemInfo assigns GetValidSaveSortNumberCount(Category)+1.

facts: SetItemQuantity assigns GetNextSortIndex when a record has no valid sort number.
GetNextSortIndex is max SortOrder among legal IDs of the same pocket plus one.
Items 50, 77 and 79 all belong to the General/Items pocket.

first_divergence: BDSP_UTILITY_ITEM_IDS mapped the max-repel semantic key to item 79. The transactional writer then correctly wrote the wrong record selected by that mapping.
root_cause: Incorrect static item identity caused by translating the OpenDPR Japanese enum name without checking the indexed localized catalog. Item 79 is Repel; Max Repel is item 77.
correction_scope: Map max-repel to 77 and, because record 77 is absent in this physical bag, create it with the exact same-pocket max SortOrder + 1 algorithm. Preserve record 79 and all unrelated records byte-for-byte, with existing preconditions, readback and rollback.
